source_semantics.summary: Current AIMWWeb DatabaseSetupService.RenderPage owns first-run setup-page composition, setup defaults, error presentation, and the database/administrator setup form.
source_semantics.security_property: Dynamic error text is HTML encoded before it is emitted into the setup page.
source_semantics.first_run_boundary: The page is pre-authentication installation UI and does not operate on an already-selected tenant resource.

laravel_adaptation.database_credentials: deployment-owned; no database password or connection string is accepted as setup page-model input
laravel_adaptation.error_encoding: Blade escaped interpolation; operation-specific acceptance proves raw script markup is not emitted
laravel_adaptation.failure_message: bounded generic operator-safe message; caught exception details are reported server-side and are not rendered
laravel_adaptation.completion_semantics: completed installations continue to redirect away from /setup rather than render first-run UI
